job: Read one blog post at reading length, with its figures, the author and related posts.
purpose: One post on Ember's blog as an fd-site-article cover: breadcrumb, title, standfirst, the author and date across the container over a picture cover (fd-site-media), then the text at reading size with a short table, a code block, a chart figure and a pull quote breaking out of the measure; tags, Copy link, the author and the newsletter sign-up at the foot, then three related posts as dated rows.
useWhen: One post published on the site.
A newsletter issue or announcement read on the web.

avoidWhen.when: A customer story told with its evidence set across the page.
A report with key facts, findings and a download.
Documentation of how to do a task.

sections.why: Shared with the blog index it belongs to; Blog is marked as the current section.

The head across the container over a picture cover the look treats, then one centred reading column; the figure and the pull quote break out, the table and code stay in it, the foot carries tags, Copy link, the author and the sign-up.
Three related posts as dated rows, the reading column's width.
After an article the reader looks for somewhere to go next.

states.name: link copied
states.how: Copy link: the button shows Copied and the copy is announced

states.name: sign-up invalid, busy, sent, subscribed
states.how: submit the foot form: data-state invalid, then busy, then sent (dana@quarry.dev: subscribed)

states.name: menu open
states.how: below 900px wide, the header's menu button opens the links as a sheet (data-state="open")
